In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This

corporate social responsibility program.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

  Our businesses bring together leading technologies, innovative solutions and hands-on expertise to

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

▼

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

## Akums Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd.: Leading the Way in Pharma Manufacturing

Akums Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd. stands as India’s largest and most trusted Contract Development
and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), redefining pharmaceutical excellence through innovation,
quality, and efficiency. As a preferred partner for leading pharmaceutical and healthcare companies
worldwide, Akums is committed to delivering groundbreaking formulations that meet evolving market
needs.

With 15+ state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, Akums offers unmatched expertise across diverse
therapeutic segments and dosage forms, including tablets, capsules, injectables, soft gels, syrups,
topicals, nutraceuticals, cosmeceuticals, derma solutions etc. Our robust R&D capabilities drive
innovation, ensuring fast, cost-effective product development that aligns with stringent regulatory
standards.

Akums is also a trusted leader in Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (API) manufacturing, ensuring a
seamless and high-quality supply of essential raw materials for pharmaceutical formulations. Our API
capabilities are in compliance with international regulatory standards, supporting the development
of superior formulations while enhancing supply chain reliability for our partners.

Quality at Akums is more than a benchmark—it is a culture. We adhere to global regulatory standards,
including WHO-GMP, USFDA, EU-GMP, and TGA, ensuring that every product meets the highest safety and
efficacy standards. Our advanced Quality Management System (QMS) and compliance-driven approach
reinforce our leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing.

Akums collaborates with 1500+ pharmaceutical companies, manufacturing over 4100+ commercialized
formulations. Our expertise extends beyond manufacturing to include formulation development,
technology transfers, regulatory support, and customized solutions, helping brands expand their
portfolios and market presence seamlessly.

While innovation fuels our growth, sustainability shapes our future. Akums integrates eco-friendly
initiatives and energy-efficient manufacturing processes, ensuring responsible business operations
that contribute to a healthier planet.

Leading the Make in India initiative, Akums continues to revolutionize global healthcare by
providing high-quality, innovative pharmaceutical solutions with a patient-first approach,
strengthening its position as a driving force in the industry.

Technology and Innovation

Our state-of-the-art facilities use advanced technology and equipment to produce high-quality,
custom medications at scale through our 503A pharmacy and 503B outsourcing facility.

Quality

Quality is built into every medication we compound. From qualified raw materials to validated
equipment and controlled cleanrooms, every step follows documented procedures aligned with
applicable cGMP and PCAB standards. Before release, batches are tested, visually inspected, and
approved by our Quality Unit with a Certificate of Analysis.

Access

Access to quality, affordable compounded medication shouldn't be limited by location. That's why
we're licensed to ship nationwide, including Puerto Rico. Ground and overnight shipping available
and discreet packaging for every order.

hormone your body synthesizes — from light. Specifically, from UVB light hitting your skin and
triggering a production cascade that no capsule can replicate.

**The supplement delivers the end compound. Your biology never runs the production process.**

Sunlight was never just about vitamin D.

When UVB hits your skin, yes — it triggers vitamin D synthesis. But it also produces vitamin D
sulfate (longer half-life than the oral form) and photoproducts that no supplement contains.

When UVA hits your skin, it releases nitric oxide directly into your blood vessels. Immediate
vasodilation. Cardiovascular support. Not a side effect of sunlight — it's a separate biological
pathway that supplements can't touch.

And a third UVA pathway activates serotonin production. The reason winter feels the way it does
isn't just psychological. It's photochemical.

**Three pathways. One session. 2 to 4 minutes.**

## **Enyrgy Vitamin D Primal Light Platform**

The only home system engineered to trigger all three biological pathways activated by natural
sunlight — vitamin D synthesis, nitric oxide release, and serotonin activation — in 2 to 4 minutes
per day.  Third-party validated spectrum: 90–95% UVB + 5–10% UVA. MED-based protocol designed by Dr.
Samantha Kimball. Automatic shutoff at your personal skin-type threshold.  Supports up to 6
household members.

[Get the Platform][10]

**THE TRIPLE-PATHWAY ADVANTAGE™**

## **One session. Three simultaneous biological responses.**

## **This is why 2 to 4 minutes of Enyrgy does what no supplement, no red light panel, and no amount
## of time outdoors in winter can do.**

***UVB converts skin cholesterol into vitamin D3, vitamin D sulfate (longer half-life than the oral
form), and photoproducts (tachysterol, lumisterol) that no supplement contains. Your immune system,
bone density, hormonal function, and disease risk are all downstream of this pathway.***

***UVA triggers nitric oxide release directly into your blood vessels, a cardiovascular pathway
entirely separate from vitamin D. Improved circulation. Blood pressure support. The data on this
pathway is in peer-reviewed literature, not wellness marketing copy.***

***UVA activates the serotonin pathway. Mood regulation. Energy. The reason winter feels the way it
does for people in northern latitudes is not purely psychological — it's photochemical. The right
light corrects it.***

Dr. Hollis has spent forty-plus years at the forefront of vitamin D research. His published work has
been cited over 70,000 times, making him one of the most referenced vitamin D scientists in the
world. He has been a pioneer in understanding the difference between oral supplementation and
UVB-synthesized vitamin D, and he validates the dosing protocols that govern the Enyrgy platform.

sunlight, and health outcomes. He used NASA UVB satellite data to establish the epidemiological

# Where

# Whole-Person Wellness

# Begins.

[ Individual coaching ][41]
[ corporate wellness options ][42]
 

## Healing the Body. Honoring the Heart. Empowering the Whole Human.

You are not a collection of symptoms. You are not just a body to be fixed, or a mind to be quieted,
or a heart to be healed. You are all of it — and the work of becoming well has to account for the
whole.

I'm Stephanie Papadakis — holistic nutritionist, grief recovery specialist, and wellness consultant
with over 15 years of experience helping people and organizations move through life's hardest
transitions with clarity, resilience, and renewed purpose.

Whether you're navigating a health crisis, a significant loss, the disorientation of a major life
change, or the quiet burnout of doing too much for too long — this work meets you where you are.

[ LEARN MORE ][43]
 

**What I Offer**

Gut of Integrity is built around one conviction: that physical health and emotional well-being are
not separate concerns.

Nourishment, grief, stress, gut function, hormonal health — they are all part of the same story. My
work brings them into conversation with each other.
* ## Nutrition Consulting
  
  Personalized, functional nutrition support for performance, gut health, hormonal balance,
  autoimmune conditions, and perimenopause. Science-backed, trauma-informed, and built around your
  actual life.
  
  [Learn more][44]
* ## Grief Support
  
  Grief lives in the body. I offer compassionate, structured support for people navigating loss —
  helping you rebuild routines, reconnect with nourishment, and find your footing again.
  
  [Learn more][45]
* ## Corporate Wellness Programs
  
  Workshops, speaking engagements, and custom wellness programs for organizations ready to invest in
  the sustained well-being of their people. Past clients include IDEO and Let’s Reimagine.
  
  [Learn more][46]
* ## Speaking & Workshops
  
  Looking for a speaker who can make nutrition, grief, and wellness accessible and engaging? I offer
  tailored presentations for health summits, podcasts, and community events.
  
  [learn more][47]

## Meet Stephanie — Your Partner in Healing and Wholeness

I'm Stephanie Papadakis, a certified **Holistic Nutritionist**, **Grief Recovery Specialist**, and
**Wellness Educator** with over 15 years of experience helping people and organizations navigate
complex health journeys with clarity and compassion. My work blends science-backed nutrition with
trauma-informed coaching to support whole-person transformation — from the gut out.

[ book a free 15-minute call ][48]
 
 

## **Why Gut of Integrity?**

> Because healing isn’t one-size-fits-all. It’s personal. It’s messy. And it’s sacred.
> 
> I named this practice to reflect what I believe deeply: that healing starts in the gut —
> physically, emotionally, and spiritually — and that living with integrity means honoring your
> body's needs without apology.
> 
> **Whether you’re here to rebalance your blood sugar, process a loss, or create a healthier
> workplace culture, this space was built for you.**

[ Yes, I'm Ready ][49]
* “I liked Steph’s style of questioning and holding of the space. She has a way of conveying
  sincerity and empathy that feels real. It's needed when working with autoimmune diseases. I felt
  understood by her as well, in the details of the disease, and my symptoms. I'm grateful for her
  support, energy, help, knowledge, and sincerity.”
  
  - Sarah, San Francisco -
* “Working with Stephanie helped me immensely. I was educated to understand my body and specific
  issues that were happening with my organs that my symptoms represented. I was especially moved by
  her warmth and genuine care towards me and what I was struggling with. The support I felt
  relationally seems like an important part to her gift. I'm so glad that I got this opportunity to
  connect with her in this way.”
  
  - Rosie, Oakland, CA

## Healing the Body. Honoring the Heart. Empowering the Whole Human.

You are not a collection of symptoms. You are not just a body to be fixed, or a mind to be quieted,
or a heart to be healed. You are all of it — and the work of becoming well has to account for the
whole.

I'm Stephanie Papadakis — holistic nutritionist, grief recovery specialist, and wellness consultant
with over 15 years of experience helping people and organizations move through life's hardest
transitions with clarity, resilience, and renewed purpose.

Whether you're navigating a health crisis, a significant loss, the disorientation of a major life
change, or the quiet burnout of doing too much for too long — this work meets you where you are.

[ LEARN MORE ][43]
 

**What I Offer**

Gut of Integrity is built around one conviction: that physical health and emotional well-being are
not separate concerns.

Nourishment, grief, stress, gut function, hormonal health — they are all part of the same story. My
work brings them into conversation with each other.
* ## Nutrition Consulting
  
  Personalized, functional nutrition support for performance, gut health, hormonal balance,
  autoimmune conditions, and perimenopause. Science-backed, trauma-informed, and built around your
  actual life.
  
  [Learn more][44]

  Grief lives in the body. I offer compassionate, structured support for people navigating loss —
  helping you rebuild routines, reconnect with nourishment, and find your footing again.
  
  [Learn more][45]
* ## Corporate Wellness Programs
  
  Workshops, speaking engagements, and custom wellness programs for organizations ready to invest in
  the sustained well-being of their people. Past clients include IDEO and Let’s Reimagine.
  
  [Learn more][46]
* ## Speaking & Workshops
  
  Looking for a speaker who can make nutrition, grief, and wellness accessible and engaging? I offer
  tailored presentations for health summits, podcasts, and community events.
  
  [learn more][47]

**Wellness Educator** with over 15 years of experience helping people and organizations navigate
complex health journeys with clarity and compassion. My work blends science-backed nutrition with
trauma-informed coaching to support whole-person transformation — from the gut out.

## Convenient & Affordable Online Lab Testing

There are many reasons why individuals order lab testing or blood work online. The most common
reasons why people use our services for lab tests online include having a high deductible, having no
insurance or not enough coverage for the testing they want or need. Additionally, millennials are
looking for a viable, affordable alternative to the Affordable Care Act (Obamacare). At
HealthLabs.com, we are able to get you the health and wellness testing you need quickly at an
affordable price.

HealthLabs.com offers an expansive collection of lab test categories and test types at discounted
rates.
* Simply order your blood or urine tests online
* Visit a [local lab][81] near you to give your blood work or urine sample for testing
* And confidentially receive your results in 1-3 days in your secure HealthLabs.com account

Your health is important! Our blood chemistry tests and [wellness tests][82] can help lead to
diagnoses and can point out any potentially problematic results that you can then take to your
doctor or general physician. Order the testing you need and receive your results quickly. We work
with major laboratories, like LabCorp and Quest Diagnostics, as well as smaller, local labs. These
labs are all CLIA-certified and often are the same labs your doctor uses!

Our online lab testing is great for monitoring conditions, disorders and diseases as well as aiding
in helping to make a diagnosis or helping to rule out various diagnoses. We have hundreds of lab
tests to choose. Some of our popular tests include:
* [Cholesterol / Lipid Panel][83]
* [Standard Health Test Panel][84]
* [Comprehensive Health Testing][85]
* [Allergy Testing][86]
* [Vitamin Deficiency Testing][87]
* [STD Testing][88]

Whether you need hormone testing, [food allergy testing][89], low-T or testosterone testing, or even
basic wellness done, HealthLabs.com's direct access testing can help you get answers to some of the
important health questions you have.

We provide a unique personal approach, day-to-day support, and all the tools you need to make your work accessible worldwide. ### Peer-review Our robust peer review ensures your work is suitable for publication and valuable to the scientific community. ### Online First On acceptance of your work, our early online publication provides access to the scientific community without delay. ### Open Access Your work will be permanently available online, free to download, share and read. ## 11,600+ Research Institutions Support Open Access at IntechOpen [View All Institutions][62] [[City University Of Hong Kong]][63] [[Iowa State University]][64] [[Fudan University]][65] [[Kings College]][66] [[Peking University]][67] [[Seoul]][68] [[Tsinghua University]][69] [[UMass Amherst]][70] [[Universidadde Buenos Aires]][71] [[Universidad Rey Juan Carlosde]][72] [[Universitatde Barcelona]][73] [[Universitéde Strasbourg]][74] [[University of Kansas]][75] [[CSIC]][76] [[University of Surrey]][77] 06 May 2026 ##### Reaching New Heights: IntechOpen Publishes its 8,000th Open Access Book IntechOpen is proud to announce a significant milestone for 2026: the publication of our 8,000th open access book. This milestone comes shortly after the 20th anniversary of the publication of our first OA book. [Read more][78] 18 December 2025 ##### 20 Years of Open Access Books: A Milestone for IntechOpen Over the past two decades, IntechOpen has grown into a global leader in open access book publishing, with an ever-expanding catalogue covering STM, as well as the social sciences and humanities. This milestone reflects not only the company’s achievements but also the growing recognition of open access books as a vital model for academic publishing, contributing to the transformation of how knowledge is shared worldwide. [Read more][79] 16 October 2025 ##### IntechOpen Among First Publishers to Go Live with OA Switchboard Books Solution We are proud to announce that IntechOpen is among the first three publishers, alongside Cambridge University Press and University of Michigan Press, to go live with the OA Switchboard Books Solution. [Read more][80] 23 April 2025 ##### IntechOpen Marked 7,500th OA Book Release with 'Climate Policies,' Co-edited by Members of ##### Nobel Peace Prize-Winning IPCC Team Co-edited by Gary Yohe and Joel Smith, senior members of the 2007 Nobel Peace Prize-winning Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), this timely volume offers a comprehensive evaluation of contemporary climate policy strategies. [Read more][81] 25 March 2025 ##### ResearchGate and IntechOpen Announce New Journal Home Partnership As part of our ongoing commitment to expanding the reach and visibility of open access research, we are excited to announce a new partnership with ResearchGate, the leading professional network for researchers. This collaboration will increase the reach and brand visibility of our journals through ResearchGate’s Journal Home platform. [Read more][82] 08 July 2024 ##### IntechOpen Presents Interviews for Young Scientists with Science's Leading Minds We are pleased to present a series of inspirational interviews for young researchers with some of today's leading scientists, ranging from a Nobel laureate to pioneers and innovators in various fields, including pharmacogenomics, pharmaceutical leadership, and academia. [Read more][83] 22 May 2024 ##### IntechOpen Reaches New Milestone: 7,000 Books Open for All IntechOpen has achieved a significant milestone in its mission to democratise scientific knowledge by announcing the publication of its 7,000th open access book, 'Towards the Eradication of* Helicobacter pylori* Infection - Rapid Diagnosis and Precision Treatment.' Guided by the expertise of Dr Liang Wang, Dr Alfred Chin Yen Tay, and 2005 Nobel Prize Laureate Prof. Barry J. Marshall, this book offers insightful research and novel approaches, contributing to the continuous discourse on *Helicobacter pylori*-related research. [Read more][84] 11 March 2024 ##### IntechOpen Signs Open Access Institutional Agreement with Iowa State University IntechOpen signs an institutional agreement with Iowa State University of Science and Technology to support open access and cover open access publishing fees for their faculty. [Read more][85] 07 June 2023 ##### IntechOpen Becomes a UKSG Member IntechOpen is now an official member of the UKSG, the UK's largest scholarly communications community. Founded almost half a century ago, it connects the knowledge community and encourages the exchange of ideas in scholarly communication. [Read more][86] 28 March 2023 ##### IntechOpen Book Wins the 2022 International Academy of Astronautics Life Science Book Award We are thrilled that the International Academy of Astronautics has chosen IntechOpen's book "Preparation of Space Experiments", edited by Dr. Vladimir Pletser, to receive the IAA Life Science Book Award. The award is given annually to recognize excellence in publication by an Academy member or corresponding member in the field of life sciences. See customer stories
[Ben Rapaport]

“I don't know what the secret sauce is, but there are definitely names that showed up on Inven that

so much faster with Inven that it’s hard to quantify.”

Craig McNally
Managing Partner, Desert Horizon Capital

## Every project still starts with the same manual work

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

325 MCG (13,000 IU) VITAMIN D3

**Maximum D3® is a high-quality vitamin D3 supplement that helps support bone health, calcium
absorption, and immune system function. **

Maximum D3® is expected to maintain adequate blood levels of vitamin D when taken once a week by
adults.

Maximum D3® was the first high-dose vitamin D3 supplement marketed in the United States. It was
designed by Dr. Grote who strongly believes in the benefits of vitamin D. He was frustrated that
high-quality supplements were not available to his patients, so he carefully formulated Maximum D3®
to have superior quality and consistency.

[ BUY NOW][158]

## 3 Main Way to Obtain Vitamin D →

## Sun

To help prevent vitamin D deficiency, adults need approximately 15-20 minutes in the sun with 40% of
the skin exposed at least 3 days per week.

## Supplements

Supplements can be a convenient and afforable method when sun exposure is limited or not an option.

## Food

Common foods that contain vitamin D are fish, eggs, mushrooms, and vitamin D-fortified foods.

The sun is the superior source of vitamin D, but sun exposure may be limited by lifestyle,
geography, and the season.

**Vitamin D deficiency has been shown to be 2.42 times more prevalent in winter than summer.**

###### One capsule of Maximum D3® contains approximately the same amount of vitamin D a
###### light-skinned person would make if exposed to summer sun for a few hours.

**Maximum D3® is a high-quality vitamin D3 supplement that helps support bone health, calcium
absorption, and immune system function. **

Maximum D3® is expected to maintain adequate blood levels of vitamin D when taken once a week by
adults.

Maximum D3® was the first high-dose vitamin D3 supplement marketed in the United States. It was
designed by Dr. Grote who strongly believes in the benefits of vitamin D. He was frustrated that
high-quality supplements were not available to his patients, so he carefully formulated Maximum D3®
to have superior quality and consistency.

## 3 Main Way to Obtain Vitamin D →

## Sun

To help prevent vitamin D deficiency, adults need approximately 15-20 minutes in the sun with 40% of
the skin exposed at least 3 days per week.

## Supplements

Supplements can be a convenient and afforable method when sun exposure is limited or not an option.

## Food

Common foods that contain vitamin D are fish, eggs, mushrooms, and vitamin D-fortified foods.

The sun is the superior source of vitamin D, but sun exposure may be limited by lifestyle,
geography, and the season.

**Vitamin D deficiency has been shown to be 2.42 times more prevalent in winter than summer.**

###### One capsule of Maximum D3® contains approximately the same amount of vitamin D a

## Concierge Medicine and Executive Health in Beverly Hills

My Concierge MD is led by Dr. David Nazarian, MD, a board-certified internal medicine physician and
nationally recognized concierge medicine expert based in Beverly Hills, California. Dr. Nazarian’s
work in personalized and preventive healthcare has been featured in major international media
outlets including BBC, CNN, FOX News, Bloomberg, Forbes, USA Today, The New York Times, Newsweek,
People Magazine, and the Los Angeles Times, as well as television programs such as Extra, E! News,
Bravo, KTLA 5, and the Dr. Phil Show, where he has served as a medical contributor and medical
editor.

Dr. Nazarian founded My Concierge MD to provide a more personalized and proactive approach to
healthcare for professionals, executives, and individuals who want direct physician access and a
comprehensive strategy for optimizing their long-term health.

After earning his undergraduate degree from UCLA, Dr. Nazarian received his medical degree from the
Sackler School of Medicine and completed his Internal Medicine residency at Huntington Memorial
Hospital, a USC-affiliated teaching hospital. Today, he combines traditional internal medicine with
advanced preventive diagnostics, regenerative medicine, and longevity science to help patients stay
ahead of disease and perform at their highest level.

“True health optimization begins with understanding each patient as an individual,” says Dr.
Nazarian. “We don’t just treat symptoms — we identify the underlying factors that influence how you
feel, perform, and age.”

[A man in light gray scrubs stands on a balcony holding a black mug, with trees and greenery in the
background.]

## Regenerative Medicine and Longevity

Modern longevity medicine is built on a deeper understanding of how the body repairs and regenerates
itself. At My Concierge MD, Dr. David Nazarian integrates regenerative medicine with traditional
internal medicine and advanced preventive diagnostics to help patients improve recovery, reduce
inflammation, and support long-term health.

As a board-certified internist practicing concierge medicine in Beverly Hills, Dr. Nazarian
evaluates each patient’s metabolic health, hormone balance, cardiovascular risk factors, and
lifestyle patterns before recommending regenerative therapies. Treatment options may include exosome
therapy, growth factor injections, peptide protocols, hormone optimization, and advanced
longevity-focused interventions, all selected based on clinical evaluation and evidence-based
guidelines.

Rather than waiting for illness to develop, Dr. Nazarian’s approach focuses on early detection,
cellular health, and metabolic optimization, helping patients maintain energy, cognitive
performance, and physical resilience as they age.

For many patients, regenerative and longevity medicine represents a shift from reactive healthcare
to proactive health optimization designed to extend both lifespan and healthspan.

[A man in light gray scrubs stands on a balcony holding a black mug, with trees and greenery in the
background.]

## Our Philosophy

At My Concierge MD, healthcare begins with understanding the whole patient. Dr. Nazarian conducts
comprehensive evaluations that consider genetics, metabolic health, lifestyle factors, stress
levels, nutrition, and long-term health goals. This broader perspective allows him to design highly
personalized treatment plans that evolve with each patient over time.

The concierge medicine model allows Dr. Nazarian to provide a level of access and continuity that is
rarely possible in traditional healthcare settings. Patients benefit from extended appointments,
direct physician communication, same-day or next-day availability, and coordinated care across
specialties when needed.

This model allows Dr. Nazarian to spend more time identifying the root causes of health concerns,
monitoring progress, and adjusting treatment strategies as patients move through different stages of
life.

Patients can receive care at the Beverly Hills office, through house calls, or via secure
telemedicine consultations, ensuring that high-quality medical care is always accessible when it is
needed most.

## Why Patients Choose My Concierge MD

The patients who seek out our practice understand that health is their most valuable asset. Many are
executives, entrepreneurs, and entertainers who require a physician capable of supporting their
demanding lifestyles while helping them perform at their highest level. Others are proactive
individuals who recognize that investing in prevention today yields dividends for decades to come.

Dr. Nazarian’s background uniquely positions him to serve this population. His training in internal
medicine provides the clinical foundation for managing complex health conditions, while his
expertise in regenerative medicine and longevity science offers patients access to therapies that
most physicians simply don’t provide.

## Concierge Medicine and Executive Health in Beverly Hills

My Concierge MD is led by Dr. David Nazarian, MD, a board-certified internal medicine physician and
nationally recognized concierge medicine expert based in Beverly Hills, California. Dr. Nazarian’s
work in personalized and preventive healthcare has been featured in major international media
outlets including BBC, CNN, FOX News, Bloomberg, Forbes, USA Today, The New York Times, Newsweek,
People Magazine, and the Los Angeles Times, as well as television programs such as Extra, E! News,
Bravo, KTLA 5, and the Dr. Phil Show, where he has served as a medical contributor and medical
editor.

Dr. Nazarian founded My Concierge MD to provide a more personalized and proactive approach to
healthcare for professionals, executives, and individuals who want direct physician access and a
comprehensive strategy for optimizing their long-term health.

After earning his undergraduate degree from UCLA, Dr. Nazarian received his medical degree from the
Sackler School of Medicine and completed his Internal Medicine residency at Huntington Memorial
Hospital, a USC-affiliated teaching hospital. Today, he combines traditional internal medicine with
advanced preventive diagnostics, regenerative medicine, and longevity science to help patients stay
ahead of disease and perform at their highest level.

“True health optimization begins with understanding each patient as an individual,” says Dr.
Nazarian. “We don’t just treat symptoms — we identify the underlying factors that influence how you
feel, perform, and age.”

[A man in light gray scrubs stands on a balcony holding a black mug, with trees and greenery in the
background.]

## Regenerative Medicine and Longevity

Modern longevity medicine is built on a deeper understanding of how the body repairs and regenerates
itself. At My Concierge MD, Dr. David Nazarian integrates regenerative medicine with traditional
internal medicine and advanced preventive diagnostics to help patients improve recovery, reduce
inflammation, and support long-term health.

As a board-certified internist practicing concierge medicine in Beverly Hills, Dr. Nazarian
evaluates each patient’s metabolic health, hormone balance, cardiovascular risk factors, and
lifestyle patterns before recommending regenerative therapies. Treatment options may include exosome
therapy, growth factor injections, peptide protocols, hormone optimization, and advanced
longevity-focused interventions, all selected based on clinical evaluation and evidence-based
guidelines.

Rather than waiting for illness to develop, Dr. Nazarian’s approach focuses on early detection,
cellular health, and metabolic optimization, helping patients maintain energy, cognitive
performance, and physical resilience as they age.

For many patients, regenerative and longevity medicine represents a shift from reactive healthcare
to proactive health optimization designed to extend both lifespan and healthspan.

[A man in light gray scrubs stands on a balcony holding a black mug, with trees and greenery in the
background.]

## Our Philosophy

At My Concierge MD, healthcare begins with understanding the whole patient. Dr. Nazarian conducts
comprehensive evaluations that consider genetics, metabolic health, lifestyle factors, stress
levels, nutrition, and long-term health goals. This broader perspective allows him to design highly
personalized treatment plans that evolve with each patient over time.

The concierge medicine model allows Dr. Nazarian to provide a level of access and continuity that is
rarely possible in traditional healthcare settings. Patients benefit from extended appointments,
direct physician communication, same-day or next-day availability, and coordinated care across
specialties when needed.

This model allows Dr. Nazarian to spend more time identifying the root causes of health concerns,
monitoring progress, and adjusting treatment strategies as patients move through different stages of
life.

Patients can receive care at the Beverly Hills office, through house calls, or via secure
telemedicine consultations, ensuring that high-quality medical care is always accessible when it is
needed most.

###### WELCOME TO NORTH GEORGIA IV

# Your mobile  IV rehydration therapy & Wellness service

[BOOK NOW][11]

Elevate your wellness with mobile IV hydration therapy from North Georgia IV and Wellness.
Experience revitalizing treatments delivered to your doorstep, recharging your body and mind
on-demand. Say goodbye to fatigue and dehydration as our experienced professionals bring hydration
and rejuvenation directly to you. Discover the convenience and revitalization of concierge mobile IV
hydration today!

[Untitled design - 2024-01-18T140414.998.png]
[8DC5C0FA-A9C5-446E-B358-52DF1BBAED9B.jpeg]

###### ABOUT US

# Hi. We’re  Rob & Ashley

We have been in the medical field with a combined total of over two decades of experience in
anesthesia, pediatric ER, and preop. We started getting IV drips to help us hydrate and feel better.
But you know what? Who wants to get in a car when you don’t feel good to get an IV? Or, you may just
want to be on your couch with your dog under a blanket. That’s where we come in. We are a concierge
mobile IV service. Whether you are trying to get a beauty bag, a hangover bag, or a variety of
wellness IV bags, we are here to help. These IVs fill you up from the inside out and can really make
a difference in your skin, your mental clarity, or your overall being. So, let us help you to get
back to being present, being well, and being hydrated.

###### STEP BY STEP

# THE  NORTH GEORGIA  IV PROCESS

#### 01

Choose your favorite Drip

At North Georgia IV and Wellness, we offer a range of drips to suit your needs. Whether you're
looking for a boost of energy, hydration, or immunity support, we have a drip that's perfect for
you.

 

#### 02

Secure your slot:

Ready to secure your spot at North Georgia IV and Wellness? Great! We know your time is valuable, so
we're happy to introduce our easy and secure booking process.



#### 03

Confirm your reservation:

Thank you for choosing North Georgia IV and Wellness. We are excited to help you on your journey to
optimal health and wellness. Please confirm your reservation below so we can prepare for your visit.

#### 04

We bring services to you.

At North Georgia IV and Wellness, we understand that taking care of your health can be challenging
with a busy schedule. That's why we bring our services directly to you, wherever you are. We offer
IV therapy and wellness services right to your doorstep.

#### 05

Enjoy your luxury drip!:

Congratulations! You've just received a luxurious IV drip from North Georgia IV and Wellness. We
hope you enjoy the benefits of this treatment and look forward to helping you on your wellness
journey.

 

[png-01_edited_edited.png]

Your concierge mobile IV rehydration therapy and wellness service

anesthesia, pediatric ER, and preop. We started getting IV drips to help us hydrate and feel better.

mobile IV service. Whether you are trying to get a beauty bag, a hangover bag, or a variety of
wellness IV bags, we are here to help. These IVs fill you up from the inside out and can really make
a difference in your skin, your mental clarity, or your overall being. So, let us help you to get
back to being present, being well, and being hydrated.

hope you enjoy the benefits of this treatment and look forward to helping you on your wellness
journey.

## Frequently Asked Questions
* ### How does Labcorp OnDemand® work?
  
  Visit the Labcorp OnDemand® website to browse and purchase laboratory tests and create your
  Labcorp Patient™ account to view your results. All Labcorp OnDemand testing requires an order from
  an authorized healthcare professional. For your convenience, Labcorp OnDemand has contracted with
  independent professional entities (collectively, Providers) to deliver healthcare provider
  services. Visit a Labcorp location for sample collection; or, if using an at-home collection kit,
  collect your sample yourself. We’ll let you know when your results are ready and can be accessed
  through your Labcorp Patient™ account.
* ### How do I create a Labcorp OnDemand account?
  
  Creating an account is fast and easy. You will need a valid email address to complete the account
  set-up. After answering a few questions and verifying your email address, you will recieve a
  confirmation email once your account is active.
  
   
  
  Get started [here][48].
* ### Does Labcorp offer blood tests near me?
  
  We have over 2,000 [Patient Service Centers][49] nationwide and over 400 Labcorp at Walgreens
  locations. You can purchase your blood test and make an appointment online.

## Frequently Asked Questions
* ### How does Labcorp OnDemand® work?
  
  Visit the Labcorp OnDemand® website to browse and purchase laboratory tests and create your
  Labcorp Patient™ account to view your results. All Labcorp OnDemand testing requires an order from
  an authorized healthcare professional. For your convenience, Labcorp OnDemand has contracted with
  independent professional entities (collectively, Providers) to deliver healthcare provider
  services. Visit a Labcorp location for sample collection; or, if using an at-home collection kit,
  collect your sample yourself. We’ll let you know when your results are ready and can be accessed
  through your Labcorp Patient™ account.
* ### How do I create a Labcorp OnDemand account?
  
  Creating an account is fast and easy. You will need a valid email address to complete the account
  set-up. After answering a few questions and verifying your email address, you will recieve a
  confirmation email once your account is active.
  
   
  
  Get started [here][48].
* ### Does Labcorp offer blood tests near me?
  
  We have over 2,000 [Patient Service Centers][49] nationwide and over 400 Labcorp at Walgreens
  locations. You can purchase your blood test and make an appointment online.

# Pharmaceutical Market Intelligence Platform

Compare drug prices, suppliers, registrations, and shortages across global pharmaceutical markets.

BOOK A PLATFORM DEMO
[product preview] Your browser does not support the video tag.

PharmaFootpath unifies global drug pricing, supplier data, registrations, shortages, and clinical
trial information into a single searchable platform. Instantly reveal market opportunities,
empowering procurement teams, wholesalers, and parallel traders to act quickly and confidently
across countries.

[RxSource]

## Pharmaceutical Market Data Is Fragmented

Pharmaceutical pricing, registrations, shortages, and supplier data are spread across national
databases, regulatory agencies, and market reports. For procurement teams and pharmaceutical
traders, gathering this information can take hours or days.

Fragmented landscape slows decision-making and limits visibility into international opportunities.

### TEAMS MUST OFTEN
* Search multiple regulatory databases
* Compare pricing between markets
* Identify licensed suppliers
* Monitor product shortages
* Track product registrations and competition

## Meet A Single Platform for Pharmaceutical Market Intelligence

PharmaFootpath aggregates pharmaceutical market data from official sources and organizes it in a
searchable cloud platform. Users can explore pharmaceutical markets in seconds, not hours.

[pill icon]

### Drug Price Comparison

Compare drug prices by country and spot new market opportunities.

[suppliers icon]

### Supplier Discovery

Find licensed distributors and wholesalers globally.

[shortage icon]

### Shortage Monitoring

Monitor medicine shortages and supply disruptions worldwide.

[arrows icon]

### Regulatory Intelligence

Access product registrations and parallel trade licenses.

## See how PharmaFootpath works in your market

Schedule a Demo

## Get Market Clarity in Seconds

### Product Explorer

Review the registration information for multiple countries in a single unified database. Filter
information by MA holders, countries, presentations, strengths, pack sizes, and other
characteristics.

### Price Comparison

Prices are converted to the currency of your choice, with daily updated currency exchange rates.
This lets you compare prices globally in a single screen, immediately.

Order information by prices, or by the largest changes in prices over the last 30 days.

### Clinical Trial Register

Search through multiple clinical trial registers in a single interface, connected to the drug
registration data and market data of PharmaFootpath.

This helps you to select a drug name or API, and then review global clinical trials currently
running with this.

### Drug Shortage Monitoring

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is a pharmaceutical market intelligence platform that aggregates drug prices,
supplier information, product registrations, shortages, clinical trials, and licensing data into one
searchable system for pharmaceutical traders, wholesalers, and procurement teams.

Who uses PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is used by pharmaceutical procurement teams, parallel traders, wholesalers, and
clinical trial supply companies that need visibility into pharmaceutical markets across multiple
countries.

Where does PharmaFootpath source its data?

PharmaFootpath gathers pharmaceutical market data from official national organizations, regulatory
agencies, and verified public sources to ensure reliable information.

How often is the data updated?

Medicine shortage data is updated daily, while most other datasets, such as product registrations
and pricing, are updated weekly depending on the source schedule.

What markets does PharmaFootpath cover?

PharmaFootpath focuses on European pharmaceutical markets with additional coverage for Switzerland,
UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Brazil, UAE, and Saudi Arabia.

How does PharmaFootpath help pharmaceutical procurement teams?

We identify where products are registered and commercialised, price information, who the
distributors are for the products, and various other details that accelerate sourcing products.

How does PharmaFootpath support parallel trade?

PharmaFootpath monitors and publishes both centrally authorised and national level parallel trade
licenses in Europe. We identify the origins of national parallel trade licenses, as well as review
and publish trends in the parallel trade markets.

How is PharmaFootpath different from traditional pharma data providers?

We're focussed on providing data to support international pharmaceutical businesses. Particularly
those looking to source internationally, export to new markets, identify unlicensed medicines, or
considering launching portfolio products internationally.

PharmaFootpath is a cloud based application, so is accessible from any laptop or PC with internet
access.

### [KYBELLA][61]

Kybella is a non-surgical injectable treatment designed to reduce submental fat, commonly known as a
double chin. It contains deoxycholic acid, which breaks down and absorbs fat cells, resulting in a
more contoured and defined jawline over time. The treatment is permanent, as the destroyed fat cells
do not return.

[Learn More ][62]

### [MICRONEEDLING][63]

Microneedling is a minimally invasive skin treatment that uses tiny, fine needles to create
micro-injuries on the skin's surface. This process stimulates the body's natural healing response,
boosting collagen and elastin production. It's commonly used to improve the appearance of fine
lines, acne scars, uneven texture, and overall skin tone. The result is smoother, firmer, and more
youthful-looking skin, with minimal downtime after the procedure.

[Learn More ][64]

component in our tissues, used to hydrate, volumize, support the skin and tissues for a more
youthful and rejuvenated appearance.

[Learn More ][52]

### [PDO THREADS][53]

a collagen boosting treatment that can provide a natural lift to tissues and improve elasticity and
texture of the skin. pdo threads are made of a complex sugar that dissolves over the course of 6 to
8 months, leaving behind collagen for continual benefits.

[Learn More ][54]

### [CHEMICAL PEELS][55]

an effective skin treatment customized to your unique skin needs that can improve tone, texture, and
treat conditions such as acne, melasma, and scarring.

[Learn More ][56]

### [LIP FILLER][57]

a cosmetic injectable  treatment with hyaluronic acid, to add volume, shape, and definition to the
lips. It enhances lip symmetry, smooths fine lines around the mouth, and can create a fuller, more
youthful appearance. The results are natural-looking and usually lasting between 6 to 18 months,
with minimal downtime.

[Learn More ][58]

### [DIAMONDGLOW][59]

a facial treatment that exfoliates, extracts, and infuses the skin with customized serums in one
step. Using a diamond-tipped wand, it gently removes dead skin cells while simultaneously
deep-cleaning pores and delivering nourishing serums tailored to the skin's needs. This treatment
leaves the skin smoother, brighter, and more hydrated, with immediate visible results and no
downtime.

[Learn More ][60]

### [KYBELLA][61]

Kybella is a non-surgical injectable treatment designed to reduce submental fat, commonly known as a
double chin. It contains deoxycholic acid, which breaks down and absorbs fat cells, resulting in a
more contoured and defined jawline over time. The treatment is permanent, as the destroyed fat cells
do not return.

[Learn More ][62]

### [MICRONEEDLING][63]

Microneedling is a minimally invasive skin treatment that uses tiny, fine needles to create
micro-injuries on the skin's surface. This process stimulates the body's natural healing response,
boosting collagen and elastin production. It's commonly used to improve the appearance of fine
lines, acne scars, uneven texture, and overall skin tone. The result is smoother, firmer, and more
youthful-looking skin, with minimal downtime after the procedure.

[Learn More ][64]

# Your health, in *plain language*.

Yasnost turns your blood work into a calm read of your body — no red-flag panic, no
one-size-fits-all averages. You drop in the PDF; we read between the lines.

Why bother

## You have the labs. You don't have *clarity*.

You drew blood. You got back twelve numbers, three red flags, and the feeling that everything is
fine and everything is wrong at the same time. That's the part we rewrite.

01 · Anxiety with no anchor

### The "normal range" isn't *your* range.

Lab reference intervals are built for an averaged population. Your age, sex, lifestyle, history —
none of that fits inside the bracket.

**Before:** "FERRITIN: 28 ng/mL · LOW"
**After:** "second drop in a quarter for you — recheck in 8 weeks"
02 · Charts with no meaning

### Is the line going up *good* or bad?

Most services hand you a stock-ticker chart. But health isn't a portfolio, and "trending up" isn't
always a win.

**Before:** 12-point chart, "↑ +34%"
**After:** "B12 has risen four months running — supplements are working, you can step down the dose"
03 · Advice with no owner

### Recommendations from *nowhere*.

An AI can fire off 14 tips in two seconds. But who decided they fit you? Who's going to do them? Who
checks they worked?

**Before:** "drink 2L of water and move more"
**After:** an 8-week plan with one task per week, and the owner is you
How it works

## Four steps from *PDF* to clarity.

Upload to understanding takes about fifteen minutes. You don't need to read the panel — that's our
job.

01 · INTAKE

#### Five minutes about *you*

Age, sex, goals, lifestyle. Enough for the report to talk to you, not to a "typical patient."

02 · UPLOAD

#### Drop the *PDF*

Any lab, any format. We pick out up to 340 markers. Nothing to type by hand.

03 · READ

#### A report in *sentences*

Not a table — a calm read. What matters, what waits, what to bring up with your doctor.

04 · PLAN

#### One thing *this week*

One task at a time. A vitamin, a recheck in 8 weeks, a consult. No checklist burnout.

Your report

## One report. One *link* for your doctor.

Every lab you've uploaded, in one place: the read, the prioritised plan, an overview of five body
systems, and the markers that need attention. Share a link with your doctor or download the PDF —
one click.

"I have three years of labs across three different labs. Used to live in a folder on my disk, things
would slip out of it. Now it's all in one place: I upload, and I stop tracking where the original
lives."

Frequently asked

## The *first* things people ask.

Is this a medical service?

No. Yasnost is an information and analytics service. We translate lab data into plain language, but
we don't diagnose and we don't prescribe.

Which labs do you support?

Invitro, Hemotest, LabQuest, Helix, CMD, KDL, Citilab and most private Russian labs. Public clinic
PDFs work too. TXT and CSV are accepted.

Where does my data live?

Encrypted on Russian servers, in line with Federal Law 152-FZ. We don't sell, share or train models
on your data. You can delete everything in one click.

How is the Health Score calculated?

It's a weighted sum across six components — biological age (25%), metabolism (20%), hormones,
inflammation, wearables (15% each) and nutrients (10%). Bio age uses the Levine PhenoAge formula on
9 markers. The same labs always produce the same score.

[Methodology →][13]How often should I retest?

Every 3 months is the sweet spot for tracking change. Pro plans include 4 uploads a year, Elite is
unlimited.

What happens if I cancel?

Your labs and PDFs stay. You move to the free plan and can export everything in one click. We don't
hold your data hostage.

Frequently asked

## The *first* things people ask.

Is this a medical service?

No. Yasnost is an information and analytics service. We translate lab data into plain language, but
we don't diagnose and we don't prescribe.

Which labs do you support?

Invitro, Hemotest, LabQuest, Helix, CMD, KDL, Citilab and most private Russian labs. Public clinic
PDFs work too. TXT and CSV are accepted.

Where does my data live?

Encrypted on Russian servers, in line with Federal Law 152-FZ. We don't sell, share or train models
on your data. You can delete everything in one click.

How is the Health Score calculated?

It's a weighted sum across six components — biological age (25%), metabolism (20%), hormones,
inflammation, wearables (15% each) and nutrients (10%). Bio age uses the Levine PhenoAge formula on
9 markers. The same labs always produce the same score.

[Methodology →][13]How often should I retest?

Every 3 months is the sweet spot for tracking change. Pro plans include 4 uploads a year, Elite is
unlimited.

What happens if I cancel?

Your labs and PDFs stay. You move to the free plan and can export everything in one click. We don't
hold your data hostage.
